Description: In 2024, there were more than 21,000 online fashion shops in the Netherlands. This number steadily increased over the years, making online fashion the biggest branch of web shops in the country. The figure aligns with the market shares of e-commerce
categories. In 2022, fashion accounted for 31 percent of the entire e-commerce market, followed by consumer electronics and media products. Read more

orders. This makes the country the seventh-largest e-commerce market in Europe in absolute terms and online shopping made up more than three percent of their GDP. Consequently, around 345 million online purchases were made by 14.1 [...] Read more

Description: Mobile commerce made up more than one-third of online sales in the Netherlands in 2023, with smartphones being more used devices than tablets. Most Dutch consumers, however, tended to use a PC for their online shopping, be it a laptop or a
desktop. As of 2022, the e-commerce market size equalled roughly 33.3 billion euros in the Netherlands. Read more
Note(s): Netherlands; Q1 2017 to Q1 2023; the figures have been taken from several publications
Source(s): GfK; Thuiswinkel.org
